description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to declare the Excise Duty on Cigarettes that shall be Payable w.e.f. 04.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which modifies excise duty rates on specific tobacco products. The content focuses on regulatory changes to existing legislation (tax rates) and is issued under statutory authority. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
